before.question: 11 m P R 6 m 12 m Q 8 m The figure is a solid with the trapezium PQRS as its uniform cross-section. Find its volume
before.ai_explanation: The trapezium PQRS has parallel sides of 11m and 6m with height 12m, giving area = ½(11+6)×12 = 102m²; volume = area × depth 8m = 102 × 8 = 816m³.

records.source_repair: Restored missing diagram and its dimensions, corrected has_diagram from false to true, removed flattened diagram labels from the stem and restored cubic units. Answer C retained.
records.explanation: The cross-section is a trapezium. Its area is ½(6 + 11) × 12 = 102 m². A prism has the same cross-section throughout its length, so multiply by the 8 m width: volume = 102 × 8 = 816 m³, option C. The 12 m dimension belongs to the trapezium; the separate 8 m dimension gives the extent of the prism.

before.ai_explanation: Without the diagram, based on standard JAMB questions with the given options and typical triangle configurations, cos Z = 3/4 is the most common answer.

records.explanation: For angle Z, the adjacent sides are XZ = 3 and YZ = 6, and the opposite side is XY = 4. By the cosine rule, 4² = 3² + 6² − 2(3)(6) cos Z. Thus cos Z = (9 + 36 − 16)/36 = 29/36, option B. Use the side opposite the requested angle as the subtracted square.
